scope: Local offline publication-candidate validation. GitHub checks and installation receipts are recorded separately for their exact commit/package.

checks.portable_and_compatibility_manifests: passed: matching identity, version, author, interface and local assets
checks.workbook_parity: passed by saved-workbook regression tests; workbook and capability registry unchanged from 0.4.0
checks.shared_discovery_report: passed: generated tables, native NO retained, proposed design_only orchestration, current and historical replay
checks.revision_3_code_assessment: passed synthetic integration: evaluated routes, repository-only exception, gap coverage and canonical service mapping parity
checks.packaging_regressions: passed: explicit marketplace identity, ZIP checksum, inventory/hash parity, hidden catalog, invalid input and overwrite rejection
checks.repository_marketplace: passed: openai-solutions entry resolves to the plugin under migrations
checks.workflow_structure: passed YAML parsing, read-only test permissions and canonical-repository release restriction; hosted execution is checked separately

not_verified: Live model requests and SDK/network integration
AWS account access, quotas or effective data-boundary settings
Model quality, latency, cache economics or application parity
known_limitations: Codex performs repository discovery; helper checks validate recorded coverage and consistency, not discovery completeness.
Evidence references and recorded decisions do not prove genuine approval or execution.
The deployment portal needs an account-specific availability verifier for inference-profile and Mantle routes.
Application helpers outside model/report scope retain their earlier explicitly dated verification boundaries.
